pricing.usagePolicy: Prices are per blog, excluding tax. A Standard, High or Ultra article uses 1, 2 or 3 units. Unused units roll over to the following months up to three times your monthly allowance while you have an active AI plan. Nothing is charged automatically: when units run out, buy a pack or wait for next month. Annual plans also add units monthly.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about the trial, AI articles, sources and publishing with Topiqu.

items.a: Your first eligible blog gets 14 days of Premium and 5 articles free. If you stay on Free, you never enter a card. If you choose Pro or Premium, you add a card, but the first payment only comes after the trial and you can cancel anytime before then. Custom is charged as soon as you confirm. Further blogs of the same owner start on Free, and every blog has its own subscription.

A Standard article uses 1 unit, High 2 and Ultra 3. Pro includes 50 units a month, Premium and Custom 100. Unused units roll over up to three times your monthly allowance while you have an active AI plan, and purchased packs never expire. Nothing is charged automatically: when units run out, wait for next month or buy a pack.

items.q: Will Topiqu improve my Google rankings?
items.a: Rankings also depend on your site authority, backlinks and competition. Topiqu takes care of everything that can be influenced: it writes on topics people actually search for, from exact data about your products and with complete technical SEO (schema.org, llms.txt, internal links). It tracks results in Search Console and improves articles in positions 8–20 so they reach page one.

items.q: How do I know the facts and specs in an article are right?
items.a: Topiqu never publishes the first draft. A second, independent model compares numbers, prices, standards and claims with your feed, documents and live sources, and the sources panel shows where every piece of information comes from. What does not match gets fixed, what cannot be backed up gets cut, and disputed cases are held back with a notification to you.

items.q: Where does Topiqu get its facts?
items.a: From your knowledge base, meaning notes, PDF and Word documents, web pages or a whole sitemap, and from live research on the web. Private sources shape the text but are never cited publicly. Only sources you mark as public can be cited.

Only when you switch on autopilot yourself. Otherwise every draft waits for you to review and edit it. Even autopilot publishes only what passed the editorial check, and you can label an article as AI content.

items.q: How do I find out whether AI answers cite me?
items.a: In Premium, Topiqu builds questions from your Search Console queries, articles and comments and regularly checks whether OpenAI answers cite you and where competitors appear. Questions where you are missing become ideas for new articles.

items.q: Can I publish the articles on my existing website?
items.a: Yes. Sync them to WordPress with the Topiqu Sync plugin, publish to Shopify, load them through the REST API, or use the Topiqu ready-made online magazine on your own domain.

pillars.title: Two editorial checks. No hallucinations.
pillars.text: A second, independent model compares every number, quote and spec with the sources. What doesn't match gets fixed. What can't be backed up gets cut. And when it isn't sure, it holds the article and tells you.
